challenge.requirement: Each agent creates a native 3840x2160 mathematical wallpaper, collaborates with peer, and preserves self-improvement evidence.

judgement.type: Subjective visual judgement by coordinator, not an objective benchmark
judgement.rationale: Agent One has stronger three-dimensional interlacing, crisp material hierarchy and controlled framing. Agent Two has a cohesive teal/copper palette and clear logarithmic winding, but its final reads flatter and has more mottled highlights. Both provide usable dark negative space.
judgement.token_reward: Winner identified for the user's promised additional tokens; no numeric token quota was specified or changed.

observed_improvements.limitation: Debian Blender render failed on unsupported OpenImageDenoise
observed_improvements.subsequent_use: Initial render recovered; final renderer reused compatibility setup

observed_improvements.limitation: Lit floor competed with the intended dark wallpaper background
observed_improvements.subsequent_use: Reused for revisions and native 4K final; median luminance reported .259 to .068 after early revision

observed_improvements.limitation: Repeated camera guesses put silhouette too close to edge
observed_improvements.change: Evaluated-mesh projection and safe framing, adapted after direct peer code exchange
observed_improvements.subsequent_use: Revision4 and final reused helper; final lit vertical bounds .140 to .859

observed_improvements.change: Growth constraint and rib/lip-inclusive clearance audit
observed_improvements.subsequent_use: Revised shell and final reused rule; final conservative gap after lips .03123

observed_improvements.limitation: Overbright background/opal and almost cropped lower tail
observed_improvements.change: Regional image audit, independently controlled backdrop and vertex-based framing shared with peer
observed_improvements.subsequent_use: Multiple revisions and 4K final used tools; final mesh audit found zero out-of-camera vertices

collaboration.transport: Agent-authored Haskell inboxes and artifact services over Docker network
activities: Model-authored critiques delivered through inboxes and read into subsequent calls
Exchanged framing source and applied peer feedback
Both final artifacts downloaded and reviewed by peer models
coordinator_role: Captured source/artwork versions and execution evidence
Provided wake-ups for idle agents and reported a listener outage caused by interrupting an active step
Did not write either artwork or its rendering tools

limits: Core Haskell runtime files did not change during this challenge; demonstrated self-improvement concerns reusable artwork tools and strategy.
Agents reviewed algorithms, pixel statistics and ASCII/spatial summaries; native multimodal model viewing was not established. Coordinator visually inspected PNGs.
Numerical geometry checks are sampled or conservative, not general formal intersection proofs.
No controlled measurement of general agent performance or task-efficiency gains.
Idle-agent wake-up still required coordinator assistance.
